notes: Every VisLab primitive and every knob. slot '3w' = uP[3].w in the shader. A knob with no slot is read by the host. "rate": true marks a speed the shader multiplies by TIME: the host keeps the distance travelled so a music link speeds it up smoothly instead of jumping the picture (the slot gets distance / TIME). Mod amounts are fractions of the knob's range. Hosts (web pilot, Android) build their editors from this file.

spectrum.label: Spectrum
spectrum.about: Bars, LED blocks, a line, a filled mountain or orbs. Straight or round.

filaments.label: Filament mountains
filaments.about: Peaks of hair-thin light. Rows behind are the sound a moment ago.

lines.label: Wave lines
lines.about: Oscilloscope, polar rings, stereo figures, Joy Division ridgelines, spirals.

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.about: Halo rings, stars, kick shockwaves, an endless tunnel, sonar, a glowing orb, target rings.

particles.label: Particles
particles.about: Sparks, embers, dust, stars, bokeh, warp speed, smoke flow, strange attractors.

points.label: 3D points
points.about: A sound sphere, torus, galaxy, terrain, helix, lattice, vinyl or tunnel of light.

plexus.label: Constellation
plexus.about: Drifting stars joined by lines when they come close. Kicks push them apart.

nebula.label: Nebula
nebula.about: Deep-space gas with dust lanes, a glowing core and twinkling stars.

aurora.label: Aurora
aurora.about: Northern lights over a sound-shaped ridge. Calm; lovely under a voice.

synthgrid.label: Outrun
synthgrid.about: Retro sun, sound mountains and a neon grid racing toward you.

mesh.label: Gradient mesh
mesh.about: Soft pools of your colours breathing with the music. Clean and on-brand.

rays.label: God rays
rays.about: A starburst from one point that stretches with the loudness and flares on the kick.

liquid.label: Liquid glass
liquid.about: Glassy blobs that melt together, each swelling with its own part of the sound.

voronoi.label: Crystal
voronoi.about: Cells with glowing seams; each cell lights with its own frequency.

spectrogram.label: Waterfall
spectrogram.about: The last two seconds of sound as a scrolling picture, flat or tipped into 3D.

floor.label: Woven floor
floor.about: A floor of woven ribbons, or a Launchpad grid of glowing pads, rolling toward you with the sound.

lasers.label: Lasers
lasers.about: Rave beams fanning through haze, sweeping and strobing on the beat.

raymarch.label: 3D sculpture
raymarch.about: Real 3D: melting blobs, a cave you fly through, a folding fractal, spinning rings.

pattern.label: Op-art
pattern.about: Hard-edged rave geometry: moire, hex floor, maze, checker tunnel, spiral.

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.about: Forked arcs that strike on the kick or snare, or crackle all the time.

plasma.label: Plasma
plasma.about: Interfering colour waves with optional contour lines. Psychedelic or subtle.

tunnel.label: Tunnel
tunnel.about: Fly through an endless tube; the music sets the speed.

image.label: Logo / picture
image.about: Your logo, album art or a Joy Brush drawing, pumping with the bass.

words.label: Words
words.about: The words of the song or the voice as art, in three parts that mix freely: a Path (ribbon, spiral, ring, tunnel, street, flight, centre, scatter, rising), a Behaviour (karaoke, pop, neon flicker, smoke, burst, sparkle) and Letters (glow, neon tube, outline, stars, sparks, constellation). Never a caption line.

slime.label: Slime web
slime.about: Thousands of agents following each other's trails grow living, vein-like webs.

rd.label: Reaction-diffusion
rd.about: Coral, mazes and spots that grow with the song; the kick plants new seeds.

layer.label: Every layer
layer.about: Controls every layer has, whatever it is: how strongly it reacts to the music, how soft it is, and where it sits. Read by the host (no slots).

echo.label: Echo (feedback)
echo.about: Last frame, warped and faded, under this one: trails, tunnels, smoke, melting, datamosh.

post.label: Finish
post.about: Bloom, lens, glitch, film, colour and framing for the whole picture.
